cognitiveType.$description: Cognitive type roles — mirror the score-king display/title/body/label/overline hierarchy but step the small roles up and relax the leading. Applied when the consumer sets [data-a11y-cognitive="true"] on the root element (the finance activation mechanism). Structure ported from finance; values re-authored to the score-king type scale and spacing primitives.

size.$description: Stepped up from body (1rem) to title (1.25rem) for readability.
Stepped up from label (0.9rem) to body (1rem).
Stepped up from overline (0.8rem) to label (0.9rem) — 0.8rem is too small for cognitive needs.

cognitiveSpacing.$description: Roomier spacing — more white space reduces visual clutter and improves scanability.

element-gap.$description: Gap between elements within a section — 16px.

cognitiveFocus.$description: Enhanced focus indicators — thicker, more visible rings.

cognitiveElevation.$description: Simplified elevation — a flatter UI reduces visual noise.

low.$description: Minimal hairline instead of a drop shadow.

raised.$description: The single soft lift, used sparingly.
